subject: AuroraMed - sustained throughput churn & cross-zone swap request
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@auroramed.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>, support@redwood.ai
Cc: Leah Gomez <leah.gomez@auroramed.com>
Date: 2028-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Spike in 5xxs and token latency - urgent

Priyom / Redwood Support,

We started seeing a large uptick in 5xx responses and sustained token latency on our US-EAST region around 08:45 PT. Throughput is churning: some requests succeed quickly, many others are erroring or timing out. This is impacting our scheduled patient-notification job and several production flows.

Attached: region_metrics.csv (summary of 08:30-09:05), kpi_screenshot.png (latency histogram).

Can you confirm if this is a regional issue or a customer-side throttling? We need a remediation path and ETA — our ops team is on standby.

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Platform Ops
AuroraMed

From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@auroramed.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, support@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-20T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xxs and token latency - urgent

Samir — thanks for the flag and for the attachments. I’m escalating to the platform engineers and ops leadership for immediate triage.

Immediate plan:
- Vanessa is investigating queue/backpressure and KV cache saturation in the US-EAST AZ3 cluster.
- If AZ3 is the source, we propose an immediate cross-zone routing swap to US-WEST-2 (canary 5% -> 25% -> full) to restore throughput while we diagnose root cause.
- We’ll flush prefix KV cache for the affected model instances and temporarily reduce max_inflight to limit retry amplification.

Request for your go/no-go: we can execute swap now and monitor 15 minutes for effect. We’ll coordinate an RTO window and provide continuous updates.

Assigning: Vanessa (SE) for technical lead; Rishi (sales/ops) for contract/credit comms; Marissa for executive visibility.

PR: Do you approve immediate routing swap? If you prefer we can open a dedicated call.

— Priyom
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@auroramed.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, support@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-20T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xxs and token latency - urgent

Samir / team — quick technical readout:
- Observed pattern: AZ3 K/V cache miss rate jumped ~4x at 08:43, token generation latency tail moved from ~120ms to ~900ms, and queue depth for GPU workers in AZ3 doubled leading to timeouts and 502/504 rates.
- Likely cause: sudden workload fanout + degraded kernel scheduling on one host class; autoscaler did not react due to transient metric aggregation lag.

Mitigation I propose (can act now if you approve):
1) Cross-zone routing swap: route new traffic away from us-east AZ3 to us-west-2 for this customer. Start with 5% canary -> 25% after 5m -> 100% if metrics improve. This requires a routing override and a temporary preference pin for AuroraMed.
2) Flush per-prefix KV caches on the affected model replicas in AZ3 and restart the 4 lagging worker pods (expected <6m).
3) Lower max_inflight for AuroraMed model route to 8 while we stabilize (from 20).

Expected effect: we should see error rate fall to baseline within 7-12 minutes of the canary reaching 25%. Small risk: short-lived increase in latency for pinned requests during drain; we’ll monitor 1m/5m SLIs.

If you approve, I’ll trigger the routing override and coordinate the cache flush with infra (support@).

— Vanessa Ortiz
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-20T09:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AuroraMed - priority pin and credits guidance

Marissa — FYI and request: AuroraMed is seeing production impact affecting patient notifications. Priyom has asked for an immediate cross-zone swap; Vanessa has a mitigation plan. Likely ask from customer after stabilization: partial service credit for 2-hour window and an assurance for improved auto-remediation config.

Recommendation: approve a short-term routing override (operational) and pre-approve a discretionary credit up to $7k if the swap and remediation restores SLIs within 30m. I’ll draft the credit note and coordinate with finance if Samir requests it.

Marissa — green to approve? If yes I’ll confirm to Priyom and Samir and prepare the post-incident credit template.

— Rishi
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@auroramed.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, support@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-20T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xxs and token latency - immediate action taken

Samir — thanks for the quick confirmation on the call. Per your go-ahead we initiated the routing override at 09:55 PT:
- 5% canary to us-west-2 at 09:55
- 25% at 10:00
- 100% completed at 10:07

Vanessa flushed prefix caches and restarted the 4 worker pods in AZ3; we also reduced max_inflight to 8 for AuroraMed route. Early metrics: error rate dropping to baseline and median token latency down to ~140ms. Full dashboard link: https://redwood.app/runbook/auroramed-202805 (internal).

Next steps: we will monitor for 60 minutes, then schedule standard post-mortem and deliver a timeline of root cause + remediation. Rishi is preparing the credit note per Marissa’s sign-off.

Appreciate your patience — please ping on this thread for live updates.

— Priyom
From: Samir Patel <samir@auroramed.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Leah Gomez <leah.gomez@auroramed.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-21T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xxs and token latency - follow-up and post-mortem request

Thanks team — service recovered quickly after the cross-zone swap and the cache flush. Error rate back to normal and job windows completed.

Request: please share the post-mortem (root cause, timeline, and concrete actions to prevent recurrence) and confirm the credit amount and any config changes you will push in our tenant (pin preference, max_inflight default change). We’ll need the post-mortem before our next leadership sync on Monday.

Appreciate the quick coordination — shout if you need anything from our side.

Best,
Samir
